fact: Article 22 of Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024, published in the Federal Negarit Gazette on 24 July 2024, requires every data controller and processor to store locally collected personal data on a server or data centre in Ethiopia, and lets the Communications Authority designate critical personal data that may be processed only in Ethiopia.
title: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024
publisher: Federal Negarit Gazette of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
